verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile + `brew bundle install`/`brew bundle check` workflow is explicitly documented as a one-command way to encode and install all project dependencies (formulae, casks, taps, and other package types) for a repo, directly matching the bootstrap-a-fresh-clone story, and `brew bundle dump` lets teams generate that file from an existing environment.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that `brew bundle install` reliably bootstraps a truly fresh clone end-to-end, and no evidence addressing edge cases like partial failures or version pinning across machines.
